title: The sphere's count needs resolution width Theta(sqrt n) and size 2^Theta(sqrt n): the proof written out
claim: Every resolution refutation of the not-all-equal formula of the octahedral knot sphere K_k (n = 4k^2 points) has width at least c1 k and size at least 2^(c2 k), for absolute constants c1, c2 > 0; width O(k) and size n^O(1) 2^O(sqrt n) suffice. Grid Sperner with the fixed one-door-per-side boundary needs width Omega(m) and size 2^Omega(m). Every lemma is proved: label states and the window criterion; single-step certificates through the old vortex (gauge equivalence off two adjacent points); straight cut systems (six straight arcs from a vortex near the centre of one octant; an exact local lemma near the vortex) with at most 18 junctions of zero-weight steps, giving d_z(x, y) >= (dist(x, y) - 19)/2; the density bad set with a Vitali covering; one large free component by counting lattice rows (replacing the isoperimetric sketch); islands (radius 1, separation 45) whose terms are >= 0 inside an island and >= 1 between islands; a hard-core random packing; for grid Sperner, three straight arcs to the doors make the fixed boundary flat, so boundary terms are >= 0 and certificates through a deep vortex never reach the boundary.
failure_conditions: A core vortex whose straight arcs meet, or whose flat state violates a line away from z, or more than 18 zero-weight junctions.
A pair of sources violating d_z(x, y) >= (dist(x, y) - 19)/2.
A blocked single step whose certificate avoids the old vortex, or a gap in the gauge-equivalence argument.
A gap in the row-counting argument for one large free component, or in the island term bounds.
For grid Sperner: a boundary that is not flat in the three-arc gauge, or a negative boundary or boundary-island term.
foundation_claim_scope: The octahedral knot spheres K_k for every k (by the proof; the local lemmas decided exactly for all k; cut systems checked on every core vortex of K_12..K_36, islands on K_48, single steps on K_30) and grid Sperner for every m (cuts checked on m = 24, 36, 48).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-11-07.
validation.status: every lemma by hand; the two local lemmas decided exactly by computation over all critical angles; the remaining lemmas confirmed on finite instances; no human or external review
validation.novelty: new as far as found: resolution width and size bounds for these formulas and for grid Sperner in general resolution (only tree-like size was known for 2D Sperner); the method is the Atserias-Dalmau game with Dantchev-Riis local randomization, and its new ingredients are single-step vortex moves, straight cut systems and island terms.
